title: first time game dev：I made a playable dreamcore survival prototype about sleepwalking,looking for honest feedback
author: SkyGlittering2579
selftext:
I’m completely new to game development, and this is my first attempt at turning one of my ideas into something people can actually play.

I’ve been experimenting with AI coding tools to see whether I could turn a dreamcore aesthetic into a playable experience. The idea I keep coming back to is sleepwalking, not just walking through a dream, but that eerie disconnect where your body seems to know the way while your mind is somewhere else.

The prototype takes place in spaces that should feel familiar, schools, childhood homes, empty pools and parking lots at night, but something is always slightly wrong. Before entering the dream, you choose a few objects to carry.Those objects affect your wakefulness, warmth, memory and signal as you move through different encounters.

Because I’m still learning,I used Codex to help me understand and build the HTML, CSS and JavaScript, along with some AI image generation during the early visual exploration. I directed the atmosphere, narrative, mechanics and overall experience, then kept testing and removing anything that didn’t feel like it belonged in the same dream.

you can play the prototype here:

[https://gil20240121-cmd.github.io/dreamcore-survival-en/](https://gil20240121-cmd.github.io/dreamcore-survival-en/)

It’s free, runs directly in the browser and doesn’t require an account.

I know it’s still rough, so honest feedback would be genuinely helpful, even basic feedback abt the interface, pacing or clarity would help me learn what to improve next.

Thanks for giving it a try.
